2585-5315-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-5315-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Grim Monolith, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

549-4693-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-4693-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.
549-4693-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

586-5258-5618-6495-6556.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-5258-5618-6495-6556.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

129-1409-4742-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2173-3845-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4986-6635--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Ambrosia Whiteheart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ambrosia Whiteheart enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Ambrosia Whiteheart trigger, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ambrosia Whiteheart
Repeat.
413-4986-6635--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

3532-5078-5705-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4067-4306-6281-7252.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

1115-1233-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-1233-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-560-3899-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

104-1545-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1545-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

147-5256-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5256-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

972-1309-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-1309-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Salvager of Secrets by paying its mana cost.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets and the Great Whale token.
When the Salvager of Secrets and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-1309-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Salvager of Secrets instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

2086-3967-6824.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-2493.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Archaeomancer with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Archaeomancer token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

271-565-1858--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
271-565-1858--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6431--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

64-372-1922.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

851-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
851-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
851-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Repeat from step 3.

3197-5147-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
3197-5147-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-5147-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

457-1409-4772.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

4944-5084.description:
Activate Illusionary Mask by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Illusionary Mask ability.
Repeat.

1849-2105-3557.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Brago and Combat Celebrant.
1849-2105-3557.description:
Declare Brago and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat each combat phase.

3086-4605-4681-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2419-3340-4231.description:
Activate Treasure Vault by tapping it, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Treasure Vault.
Repeat.

1627-2034-2205-4275.notablePrerequisites: Imperious Perfect and Llanowar Elves do not have summoning sickness.
1627-2034-2205-4275.description:
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Imperious Perfect by paying {G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Faces of the Past, untapping all Elves and Warriors.
Repeat.

210-220-5195-5291.description:
Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Storm-Kiln Artist until end of turn.
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Cursed Mirror each trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve Chain Lightning, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter, and causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, targeting Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Cursed Mirror each trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing 3 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist and Cursed Mirror triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4.

539-1247-4178.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-4178.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
